rows.Origin:
Bred by K.S. Gopalaswamiengar (India, before 1974).
Introduced in India by KSG Sons/KSG's Roses in 1974 as 'Nartaki'.
rows.Bloom: Mauve, golden-yellow stamens, ages to lavender . Single (4-8 petals), in small clusters bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
